query:
INSERT INTO ersd_versions (id, account_id, version, language, text_sha256, body, published_at, created_at)
               SELECT $1, $2, COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1, $3, $4, $5, $6, $6
               FROM ersd_versions WHERE account_id = $2 AND language = $3
               RETURNING version
